Recorded SHA256 receipts and historical /tmp preview bytes are distinct evidence kinds; duplicate references do not extend unique file coverage.
A digest difference denotes actual bytes differing from that historical baseline, even if another newer receipt matches. It does not establish that migration caused the difference.
Only a current byte stream whose reverse root-path substitution recovers the exact historical SHA is classified as a path-text rewrite.
Files without an earlier recorded digest or retained byte copy are explicitly unverified for migration byte preservation; current hashes are inventory only.
